body: Docs integration note for the owner’s requirement: when the first `storyatlas4s inspect` vertical slice is immutable, it should get a task guide that shows the exact command, emitted bundle tree, manifest/result excerpts, the filesystem-openable preview, and both scientific states: surface-only semantics Unestablished and fixture/model validated full-path output. Until that command exists, the current docs candidate is correct to say storymodel4s has canonical JSON and renderer-neutral views but no HTML bundle command. Treat the future bundle guide as a follow-on bound to the exact CLI/output candidate, not prose describing an aspirational interface.
